preprocessing_contract.input: Bounded 3D non-contrast head CT volume in Hounsfield Units (NIfTI or DICOM; up to 32 million voxels at 1 mm isotropic and 150 million native voxels)
preprocessing_contract.geometry: Upstream BLAST-CT axis reorientation and linear resampling to 1.0 mm isotropic spacing (out-of-bounds fill value set to image minimum intensity), followed by nearest-neighbour resampling of predicted 5-class labels back to native geometry
preprocessing_contract.normalization: Hounsfield Unit clamping to [-15, 100] linearly mapped to [-1, 1] (IntensityWindowNormalization)
preprocessing_contract.prediction: 3D DeepMedic v2 multi-centre model checkpoint 1 (3 multi-scale pathways at factors 5, 3, 1; 8 valid 3x3x3 convs per path; 5 output classes: background, IPH, EAH, oedema, IVH) evaluated with dynamic non-overlapping tile grids ((80 + 15k) input -> 15k output; 125^3 on WebGPU, 155^3 on WASM CPU, shrunk edge tiles) and argmax class assignment
